text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet, you were so dashing as a
bartender. The
way you tossed and
twirled those bottles and
glasses! My
heart fluttered just watching. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And the mocktail you made for me was
so good...
Hehe, thank you for the
wonderful night. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What praise! And coming from Lady
Shamrock
herself—I am honored and
delighted!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just curious, did you set up that
makeshift
bar in the school cafeteria just
for me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I did mention the other day how I was
curious to
know what a bar was like, but
would never
actually get to visit one.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A whimsical muse whispered into
my ears,
that is all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Say, Kris, would you happen to
know
anything? You were helping
Gimlet, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was an assistant. I did only trivial
things. Getting
permission to use the
cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Asking your security about your tastes...
Looking
for a four-leaf clover to put on
the mocktail...
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You're free to interpret things
how you
like.
